source.rationale: D2. probe-customer-orders now carries onError: continueRegularOutput (D1), because after the splice this lane runs an LLM + MCP round-trip where today it is pure code that cannot fail - and a transient failure must not drop a turn that currently always answers. The cost of D1 is that the failure arrives here as an ordinary item, indistinguishable from 'we looked and found nothing' unless something checks. Neither `answers` nor `items` being an array is that check. On a failure the node must render the BARE picker - byte-identical to what not-found-error-message produces today (escalate_message = gate.gate_clarification) - and NOT the confident '- no delivery' on every line, and NOT the 'None of these have a matching delivery.' close, which is the same false claim in one sentence instead of three.
